chunks: Beware! Do not obey him, but bow in adoration and draw near (to your Lord).
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command instead of obeying the disbeliever in Surah Al-Alaq?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a directive to reject the dominion of the ego (nafs) or the archangel of death, redirecting focus toward humble prostration (sujud) as the primary means of spiritual ascent. The command to 'draw near' (iqtarib) signifies the culmination of worship in achieving closeness to the Divine, a concept central to the Shia understanding of tawhid and spiritual purification. This act of submission serves as the antidote to the arrogance of the self, aligning the believer with the cosmic order of servitude to God.
